featured_recipes.title: Creamy Garlic Pasta
instructions: Boil the pasta in salted water until tender.
Heat butter in a pan and sauté the garlic until fragrant.
Pour in the cream and stir gently.
Add parmesan cheese and mix until the sauce becomes creamy.
Drain the pasta and add it to the sauce.
Mix well and serve hot.

featured_recipes.title: Grilled Chicken Bowl
instructions: Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and your favorite spices.
Grill the chicken until fully cooked and golden.
Prepare rice or quinoa as the base.
Chop fresh vegetables like cucumber, tomato, and lettuce.
Slice the grilled chicken into strips.
Arrange everything in a bowl and serve with sauce.

featured_recipes.title: Classic Margherita Pizza
instructions: Preheat the oven to a high temperature.
Roll out the pizza dough on a floured surface.
Spread tomato sauce evenly over the dough.
Add fresh mozzarella slices on top.
Bake until the crust is golden and cheese is melted.
Top with fresh basil leaves and serve.

featured_recipes.title: peperoni Pizza
instructions: Preheat the oven to a high temperature.
Roll out the pizza dough on a floured surface.
Spread tomato sauce evenly over the dough.
Add fresh mozzarella slices on top.
Add fresh peperoni slices on top.
Bake until the crust is golden and cheese is melted.
Top with fresh basil leaves and serve.

popular_meals.title: Beef Burger
instructions: Season the beef patty with salt and pepper.
Cook the patty on a hot grill or pan until done.
Toast the burger buns lightly.
Add lettuce, tomato, cheese, and the beef patty to the bun.
Spread your favorite sauce on top.
Close the burger and serve warm.

popular_meals.title: Chicken Shawarma
instructions: Marinate the chicken with shawarma spices and yogurt.
Cook the chicken in a pan until browned and tender.
Warm the wrap bread or tortilla.
Add garlic sauce, pickles, and sliced chicken.
Roll the wrap tightly.
Slice and serve immediately.

popular_meals.title: Sushi Platter
instructions: Cook sushi rice and let it cool.
Place a sheet of seaweed on a bamboo mat.
Spread rice evenly over the seaweed.
Add your fillings like salmon, cucumber, or avocado.
Roll tightly and slice into pieces.
Serve with soy sauce, ginger, and wasabi.

recommended_recipes.title: Avocado Toast
instructions: Toast the bread slices until golden.
Mash the avocado in a bowl with salt and pepper.
Spread the mashed avocado over the toast.
Add chili flakes or lemon juice if desired.
Top with eggs or tomatoes if you like.
Serve fresh.

recommended_recipes.title: Chocolate Pancakes
instructions: Mix flour, cocoa powder, sugar, milk, and eggs in a bowl.
Whisk until the batter is smooth.
Heat a non-stick pan and pour a small amount of batter.
Cook until bubbles form, then flip.
Repeat until all batter is used.
Serve with chocolate sauce or fruits.

recommended_recipes.title: Caesar Salad
instructions: Wash and chop the lettuce.
Prepare the Caesar dressing or use ready-made dressing.
Add croutons and parmesan cheese to the lettuce.
Pour the dressing over the salad.
Toss everything together well.
Serve chilled.
